entities.summary: Antonio Zatta was an Italian cartographer and publisher who was based in Venice. He may have lived from about 1722 to 1804. One of his major contributions includes the Atlante Novissimo, a four volume atlas of the world. Also, his grand study of St Mark's Basilica in Venice, printed in 1761.
